items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I had worked with him on a one-night thing... So he hired me and Phil and a drummer to play a gig... we stayed together for about...oh, I guess from '61 up until about '63 or '64.

ctx.x: Well, George Wein called me, you know, and he asked me if I would be interested in doing some gigs with him. So I said, 'Yeah, sure, why not?' Work for him, I might as well. I wasn't doing anything with anybody else. So he said, 'Well, what do you want to work with?' I had heard Phil Porter up in Boston, because I had worked with him on a one-night thing, and he... Jimmy Tolliver had the band up there. So he got Phil to play in his organ player's place, because it was his band, really, and I was just the added…

So when George asked me what I wanted to do, what I wanted to work with, I thought about Phil. I said, 'Well, I'd like to get this little organ player and get myself organized when there was a trio,' because it would be easy to work in a trio and I could work in any type of club, whereas there don't have to be a whole lot of money for me
